title: `property_can_revert` and `property_get_revert` not working
body:
### Tested versions

4.4

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - macOS Sequoia (15.6.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M1 Pro (Apple7) - Apple M1 Pro (10 threads)

### Issue description

When calling `property_can_revert` and `property_get_revert` on a property which has a default, it doesn't return the default value.

Code:
```gdscript
extends Node2D

@export var foo = 1

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
    print(property_can_revert("foo"))
    print(property_get_revert("foo"))
```

Output:
```
false
<null>
```

The documentation says that we need to implement `_property_can_revert` and `_property_get_revert` for it to return correctly which seems to mean `property_can_/get_revert` just mirrors `_property_can_/get_revert`, just with `property_can_/get_revert` being callable even if the user didn't define them. I don't know whether it's actually just that but I can't find any differences in my experiments. And if it was just that, that would mean it's just a convenience function over `_property_can_/get_revert` which seems pretty meaningless and useless for anyone, gamedevs and engine developers alike, because it doesn't provide any more useful information than just calling `_property_can_/get_revert` instead which would just be two lines of code with checking that the method exists. Convenience function over such a thing seems to be out of place and also not something implied by the name.
Trying to get the default value of a regularly defined property dynamically seems like a valid use case and the functions' names seem to imply to provide that but doesn't.
I don't know whether it is intended this way but if it wasn't, please fix it and make `property_can_/get_revert` work with regular properties. If it was intended this way, please add a function for retrieving defaults of regular properties with clear names for distinguishing between them and I would also propose to reconsider that because I think it would be more useful than the current behaviour.

### Steps to reproduce

Make new project, make scene with `Node2D`, attach above script to it and run the scene.
